question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given set. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /Substract /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(4, 8, 35)

(3, 5, 23)
solution:

Logic: (1st number + 2nd number) × 3 - 1 = 3rd number.

Now,

⇒ (4 + 8) × 3 - 1
